userStatement: 阴影是否需要处理，比较明显
scope: Reduce excessive baked directional shadows on the left platform and broad dark patches under the tower and awning; retain light contact shading. No runtime shadow changes.

edits.knownIssue: Requested transparency was not produced; checkerboard is baked into RGB. This intermediate is not a usable transparent asset.

edits.role: Prepare green backdrop for the existing building key pipeline

observedResult: Large baked shadow on the left platform is substantially reduced; tower/awning wall and stone texture are more readable. Light occlusion at stone joints, post feet and under eaves remains.
limitations: Generative edits introduce minor surface texture differences; no byte-identical claim
Original artwork and all direct editing ancestors are retained
Game dimensions, grounding and footprint mapping remain uncalibrated
validationBoundary: Offline asset production, file channel inspection and previews only; no tests, build or runtime validation.

approval.scope: Artwork accepted as the current industrial recon-camp final; runtime installation and in-game calibration are not performed in this turn.
